questions.formal_statement: Does a balanced Boolean function f:F_2^9 -> F_2 with nonlinearity at least242 exist? Equivalently, wt(f)=256 and max_a |sum_x (-1)^(f(x)+a dot x)|<=28.
questions.relation_to_book: The smallest odd n>=9 instance of the book's explicitly open balanced-nonlinearity and above-bent-concatenation construction question.
questions.solved_means: An explicit balanced f:F_2^9->F_2 whose 512 Walsh coefficients all have magnitude at most 28, independently verified (settles existence at n=9 only), or a complete proof that none exists.

identified_counterpart.zh_quote: 当 n 为奇数且 n≥9 时，n 元平衡布尔函数的最大非线性度还不知道。……如何构造非线性度严格大于 2^{n−1}−2^{(n−1)/2} 的奇数个变元的非 Patterson-Wiedemann[5] 型平衡布尔函数也是目前颇受关注的问题。
identified_counterpart.en: When n is odd and n ≥ 9, the maximum nonlinearity of n-variable balanced Boolean functions is still not known. … How to construct balanced Boolean functions in an odd number of variables, not of Patterson–Wiedemann [5] type, whose nonlinearity is strictly greater than 2^{n−1} − 2^{(n−1)/2} is also a problem that currently attracts considerable attention. [Context from the preceding sentence: for odd n ≤ 7 the maximum nonlinearity of Boolean functions is 2^{n−1} − 2^{(n−1)/2}, and it can be attained by a balanced function. For the selected instance n = 9, 2^8 − 2^4 = 240.]

identified_counterpart.formal_statement:
Definitions (as in the article, p. 425): B_n is the set of Boolean functions f: F_2^n → F_2. L_n = {φ_α + ε : α ∈ F_2^n, ε ∈ F_2} is the set of affine functions, where φ_α(x) = α·x = ⊕_i α_i x_i. The nonlinearity is N_f = min_{l ∈ L_n} d_H(f, l), where d_H is the Hamming distance between truth tables. f is balanced if its truth table has equally many 0s and 1s, i.e. wt(f) = 2^{n−1}. Equivalently, with the Walsh transform W_f(α) = Σ_{x ∈ F_2^n} (−1)^{f(x) ⊕ α·x}, N_f = 2^{n−1} − (1/2)·max_{α ∈ F_2^n} |W_f(α)|.

Selected question [ASSUMPTION: the restriction to n = 9 comes from the owner's selection; the article states the problem for every odd n ≥ 9]: Does some f ∈ B_9 with wt(f) = 256 have N_f > 2^8 − 2^4 = 240?

Derived equivalence (not an assumption): suppose f is balanced and n ≥ 2. Then W_f(0) = 0. For α ≠ 0, d_H(f, α·x) = 2^n − 2|supp f ∩ supp(α·x)|, which is even. So every W_f(α) ≡ 0 (mod 4) and N_f is even. The question is therefore equivalent to: does some f ∈ B_9 with wt(f) = 256 satisfy max_{α ∈ F_2^9} |W_f(α)| ≤ 28, i.e. N_f ≥ 242?

The article's broader statements, kept separate:
(i) Literal: for odd n ≥ 9, max{N_f : f ∈ B_n balanced} 'is still not known' (an exact value is wanted).
(ii) Literal: for odd n, construct balanced f ∈ B_n with N_f > 2^{n−1} − 2^{(n−1)/2} that are not of Patterson–Wiedemann type.
[ASSUMPTION: the selected n = 9 existence question drops the 'non-Patterson–Wiedemann type' qualifier of (ii). The article does not define 'Patterson–Wiedemann type'; reference [5] concerns n = 15.] A positive answer for n = 9 shows that the balanced maximum exceeds 240, but it does not by itself give the exact maximum asked for in (i).
identified_counterpart.solved_means: Either: (a) give an explicit balanced Boolean function on 9 variables (for example its 512-bit truth table with exactly 256 ones) whose Walsh spectrum satisfies max_α |W_f(α)| ≤ 28, i.e. nonlinearity ≥ 242. This can be checked directly with a fast Walsh–Hadamard transform. Or: (b) prove that every balanced 9-variable Boolean function has some Walsh coefficient with |W_f(α)| ≥ 32, i.e. nonlinearity ≤ 240. Fully settling the article's underlying n = 9 question would also require the exact maximum nonlinearity of balanced 9-variable functions, meaning a matching upper bound and construction.

verdicts.source: Yueying Lou and Qichun Wang, [Search for 9-Variable Boolean Functions with the Optimal Algebraic Immunity-Resiliency Trade-Off and High Nonlinearity](https://globals.ieice.org/en_transactions/fundamentals/10.1587/transfun.2023EAL2111/_f), IEICE Transactions on Fundamentals E107-A(8), 1382–1385.

literature.summary: As of 2026-10-15, q1 remains open in the checked literature: [Lou and Wang (2024)](https://globals.ieice.org/en_transactions/fundamentals/10.1587/transfun.2023EAL2111/_f) explicitly leave balanced nine-variable nonlinearity above 240 unresolved, and the best located balanced value remains 240. [Wang, Lou and Wang (2026), §6](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.17871v1) still leave balanced attainment of 242 open despite claiming the unrestricted covering radius is 242.

sources.citation: Yueying Lou and Qichun Wang, [Search for 9-Variable Boolean Functions with the Optimal Algebraic Immunity-Resiliency Trade-Off and High Nonlinearity](https://globals.ieice.org/en_transactions/fundamentals/10.1587/transfun.2023EAL2111/_f), IEICE Transactions on Fundamentals E107-A(8), 1382–1385.
sources.finding: The introduction explicitly states that existence of balanced nine-variable functions with nonlinearity greater than 240 remains undetermined. Its own maximum of 224 applies only to rotation-symmetric functions satisfying the optimal algebraic-immunity/resiliency trade-off; it is not an upper bound for arbitrary balanced functions.

sources.citation: Selçuk Kavut and Melek Diker Yücel, [9-variable Boolean functions with nonlinearity 242 in the generalized rotation symmetric class](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0808.0684), Information and Computation 208(4), 341–350; accessed through the 2008 author manuscript.
sources.finding: Supplies explicit nine-variable nonlinearity-242 functions in generalized rotation and dihedral classes. These examples have no zero Walsh coefficient, so adding a linear function cannot balance them. They establish an unrestricted RM(1,9) covering-radius lower bound, not the balanced existence result.

sources.citation: Qichun Wang, Yueying Lou and Zifan Wang, [The Covering Radius of the Reed–Muller Code RM(1,9) is 242](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.17871v1), arXiv:2610.17871v1, submitted 13 October 2026.
sources.finding: Claims that the unrestricted maximum nonlinearity is 242. Section 6 explicitly leaves existence of a balanced nine-variable function attaining 242 open. No refereed publication was identified by the cutoff; its claimed upper bound is not treated as established and does not resolve balanced attainment.

sources.citation: Yueying Lou, Youle Xu and Qichun Wang, [The Maximum Nonlinearity of 8-variable Balanced Boolean Functions is 116](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.17897v1), arXiv:2610.17897v1, submitted 13 October 2026.
sources.finding: Claims a resolution for eight variables, a different dimension. Its conclusion lists existence of a balanced nine-variable function with nonlinearity 242 as Open Problem 1. No refereed publication was identified by the cutoff.

sources.citation: 张卫国、李路阳, [流密码中的布尔函数设计研究进展](https://www.htu.edu.cn/_upload/article/files/35/13/4741c0b54d1fb5d898dc4d352aee/da064846-9fad-48ce-8be2-719a91404fc5.pdf), 河南师范大学学报（自然科学版）45(3), 24–33.
sources.finding: Later work by the book's first author, directly citing the 2011 article as reference [3]. It surveys resilient-function constructions and poses maximum-nonlinearity questions, without supplying a balanced nine-variable 242 construction or a universal balanced upper bound of 240.

sources.citation: Yibo Zhang, Yu Wang, Qichun Wang, Yinxia Sun and Zhipeng Yu, [New Results on Boolean Functions with High Nonlinearity and Low Transparency Order](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1155/2023/5189651), Security and Communication Networks, article 5189651.
sources.finding: Table 1 explicitly labels its nine-variable nonlinearity-242 examples f2 and f3 as unbalanced, including the example obtained without restricting the search space. Its balanced examples f1, f4 and f5 have nonlinearity 240.

sources.citation: Marko Djurasevic, Domagoj Jakobovic, Luca Mariot and Stjepan Picek, [A survey of metaheuristic algorithms for the design of cryptographic Boolean functions](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12095-023-00662-2), Cryptography and Communications 15, 1171–1197.
sources.finding: Reviews 25 years of heuristic Boolean-function design and the difficulty of determining attainable balanced nonlinearity. It provides search methods and references, but no balanced nine-variable 242 witness or impossibility proof. Heuristic failure supplies no exhaustive exclusion.

sources.citation: Selçuk Kavut, Subhamoy Maitra, Sumanta Sarkar and Melek Diker Yücel, [Enumeration of 9-Variable Rotation Symmetric Boolean Functions Having Nonlinearity > 240](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/11941378_19), INDOCRYPT 2006, LNCS 4329, 266–279.
sources.finding: Reports exhaustive enumeration: 1512 ordinary rotation-symmetric functions have nonlinearity 241, and none has larger nonlinearity. Consequently, balanced functions in this class have nonlinearity at most 240, using evenness of balanced nonlinearity. This excludes the class, not arbitrary Boolean functions.

angles.angle: Exact balancing neighborhoods of the explicit Kavut–Yücel seeds, including linear output shifts.
angles.deliverable: For f=g⊕z, encode W_f(a)=W_g(a)−2Σ_x z_x(−1)^(g(x)+a·x), impose all 512 inequalities −28≤W_f(a)≤28, W_f(0)=0, and Σz_x≤r. The three published §3 seeds have minimum balancing distances 6, 6 and 14 at their original origins; smaller radii there are vacuous. Their minimum Walsh magnitude is 4, allowing linear output shifts with minimum balancing distance 2. Start with complete radius-2 searches, then bounded radius-4/6 instances. Deliver a witness or an exactly identified, proof-checked neighborhood exclusion with independently reconstructed constraints, planted satisfiable controls and direct-Walsh encoding audits; UNKNOWN is inconclusive.

angles.angle: Seeded search among balanced truth tables using weight-preserving swaps and incremental Walsh updates.
angles.deliverable: Start from balanced modifications of the verified seeds and known nonlinearity-240 functions; minimize penalties for Walsh magnitudes above 28, using restarts to escape plateaus. Success requires an indexed 512-bit table, explicit bit order, SHA-256, weight 256, all 512 coefficients, and Python3 verification by both integer FWHT and direct character sums. Report any nonlinearity 244 witness without assuming the preprint's upper bound. An unsuccessful search yields logs, not an exclusion.

acceptance.solved: An explicit balanced f:F_2^9->F_2 whose 512 Walsh coefficients all have magnitude at most 28, independently verified (settles existence at n=9 only), or a complete proof that none exists.
acceptance.refuted: a verified counterexample or negative answer to the stated question itself
acceptance.partial: An exactly scoped verified result, such as non-vacuous seed-neighbourhood or symmetry-class exclusions with audited encodings, or an exact class maximum with an attaining witness.

owner_selection.title_zh: 弹性布尔函数的非线性度的紧上界
owner_selection.question: Does a balanced Boolean function f:F_2^9 -> F_2 with nonlinearity at least242 exist? Equivalently, wt(f)=256 and max_a |sum_x (-1)^(f(x)+a dot x)|<=28.
owner_selection.relation_to_book: The smallest odd n>=9 instance of the book's explicitly open balanced-nonlinearity and above-bent-concatenation construction question.
owner_selection.baseline: Best located balanced9-variable nonlinearity is240. Kavut-Yucel have unbalanced242 functions with no zero Walsh coefficients. Two 2026-10-13 preprints still list balanced9-variable242 as open.
owner_selection.bounded_target: Primary success: an explicit512-bit truth table verified balanced and nl>=242 by an independent full Walsh computation. Otherwise attempt precisely delimited local-neighborhood or small symmetry-class exclusions; those are sub-questions only.
owner_selection.angle: Exact local balancing around the staged unbalanced242 seed tables; use z3 or cardinality SAT with independently reconstructed Walsh constraints. Concurrently try a seeded heuristic. Limit exact symmetry enumeration to feasible classes, after checking it is not already prior art.
owner_selection.risk: Low probability of a positive242 witness in six hours. A timeout or heuristic non-find proves nothing. Two solvers sharing one encoding are not a model-independent certificate; unsupported UNSAT claims are not accepted. Do not assume the unrefereed claimed upper bound242 to validate a positive witness.
review_requirements: Positive success requires an explicit indexed 512-bit truth table, its bit order and SHA-256, weight 256 after any linear balancing step, and every Walsh coefficient magnitude at most 28. Verify independently using FWHT and direct character sums.
Search for max|W|<=28 with some W(a)=0; adding a linear function a.x then balances without changing nonlinearity.

A positive witness establishes existence only for n=9. Do not claim optimality, maximum balanced nonlinearity 242, or a general odd-n construction. The 2026 upper-bound claim is unrefereed and must not be used; nonlinearity 244 would contradict it and must be reported as such.
Local radii below the forced distance |W_g(0)|/2 are vacuous. Report this minimum next to each radius. The weight-242 seed with W(0)=28 needs r>=14.

Before enumeration, screen every symmetry class for an affine conjugate of the nine-cycle coordinate shift. Such classes are affine-equivalent to rotation-symmetric functions and already excluded at nonlinearity 242; e.g. multiplicative F_8* plus Frobenius is already settled.

A negative result needs the exact seed/radius or class definition, justified completeness, and independently audited question-to-encoding correspondence: planted solvable variants and random assignments checked against direct Walsh calculation. Several solvers on one CNF are one unchecked result. Timeout, UNKNOWN, and heuristic non-find prove no absence. An exact class maximum also needs an attaining witness.
owner_selection.solved_means: An explicit balanced f:F_2^9->F_2 whose 512 Walsh coefficients all have magnitude at most 28, independently verified (settles existence at n=9 only), or a complete proof that none exists.
owner_selection.partial_means: An exactly scoped verified result, such as non-vacuous seed-neighbourhood or symmetry-class exclusions with audited encodings, or an exact class maximum with an attaining witness.
shared_scope_rules: No automatic revisit, refill, extra problem, paid-API fallback, model/config change, scheduler, commit, push, or external contact.
A special case, finite search range, or improved bound is partial progress, not resolution of a broader book question.
Sampling is not independent exhaustive verification. Numerical negativity is not a theorem without its analytic bridge. Solver UNKNOWN is not UNSAT.
Openness and novelty are dated search verdicts. Preprints and openai/math are claims until independently established.
shared_review_overrides: This manifest and parent restrictions override stronger promises, confidence labels, and schedules in the screening catalogs.
The 14,400-second attack is part of each 21,600-second visit, not an extra allowance. Early termination and inconclusive outcomes are valid; no refill is implied.
Reserve new best, improved, or novel wording for the visit literature and novelty assessments; reproduction and restricted results keep their exact scope.

The replay sandbox forbids executing binaries created inside the attack directory. Every claims.json verify/check/control command must run with python3 or preinstalled system tools; preserve compiled-production logs as evidence instead.
